label: Positive
description: Rounded character, identity treated with dignity, not defined solely by queerness.

label: Mixed
description: Some positive elements, some problematic; nuance required.

label: Tokenized
description: Queer identity present but underdeveloped or used as set dressing.

label: Harmful
description: Portrayal reinforces negative stereotypes or tropes.

label: Historical Context
description: Older work; assessed within its era rather than by current standards.
